### <span class="imp imp-3" title="Importance 3/5" aria-label="Importance 3 of 5"><i class="on"></i><i class="on"></i><i class="on"></i><i></i><i></i></span> Payroll Pirates AiTM phishing campaign hijacks Microsoft 365 sessions
Cybercriminals launched a widespread phishing campaign called "Payroll Pirates" using adversary-in-the-middle (AiTM) tactics to hijack Microsoft 365 sessions and steal payroll and finance data. Arctic Wolf Labs identified the ongoing campaign targeting organizations in healthcare, education, manufacturing, and across the United States. The attackers use AiTM phishing infrastructure to compromise Microsoft 365 accounts despite multi-factor authentication (MFA) being in place. Once sessions are hijacked, the threat actors use residential proxies and access the Microsoft Graph API to enumerate and collect emails from payroll and finance mailboxes. The campaign is financially motivated, seeking to exfiltrate sensitive payroll and financial information for fraud purposes. The threat actor behind the campaign is linked to Storm-2755. The phishing campaign successfully bypasses traditional MFA protections by intercepting and proxying authentication flows between users and Microsoft 365 services.
